text: Assumption: The lifetime of the string referenced by ToString() is bound to the underlying instance or static memory — is this correct?

assumption: The lifetime of the string referenced by ToString() is bound to the underlying instance or static memory.
rationale: [SWS_CM_11519] returns an ara::core::StringView, which by standard semantics takes no ownership of the character data.
